scope: local verification orchestration, governance entrypoints, duplicate execution, side-effect boundaries, and measured feedback latency

inventory.currentEvidencePolicy: historical evidence is non-authoritative unless curated by docs/evidence/index.json

confirmedRootCauses.evidence: pre-fix dry-runs for docs-only, API-only, Web-only, Worker-only, and governance-only each selected all eight Quick orchestration steps before the focused command
confirmedRootCauses.impact: changed-path selection did not reduce ordinary coding feedback

confirmedRootCauses.evidence: Quick ran frontend tests and release/Slice UI behavior guard ran the same Vitest suite again
confirmedRootCauses.impact: about one additional frontend test-suite duration on affected paths

confirmedRootCauses.evidence: AGENTS.md still named tools/run-gates.ps1 as test/full and declared hotspot gate_na after focused profiles and a hotspot guard existed
confirmedRootCauses.impact: agents could continue selecting the 235-step stateful compatibility audit

confirmedRootCauses.evidence: Get-VerificationSelection returned pass with zero selected commands when neither changed paths nor a matching task were present
confirmedRootCauses.impact: a zero-step Slice could be misreported as verified

repairs: Slice no longer invokes Quick; selected commands own their minimal build/test/contract/hotspot chain
API Slice runs backend build then tests with --no-build
Web Slice runs frontend build, lint, and tests only
Worker Slice runs compileall then worker tests only
docs/governance Slice runs only selected deterministic contracts
empty and unknown Slice selections fail closed
UI behavior guard uses -SkipTests after the owning profile already ran frontend tests
AGENTS.md and current strategy/roadmap entrypoints now route ordinary work to Slice and reserve legacy audit for explicit compatibility checks

postFixMeasurements.decision: retain as an explicit full-stack stateless baseline; do not invoke it implicitly from Slice
retain full 44-test behavior suite; Vitest related mode was faster but was not adopted because the current test topology does not yet prove fail-closed coverage for every source path

retainedBoundaries.quick: full-stack stateless baseline, targeted at roughly one minute
retainedBoundaries.legacyAudit: 235-step compatibility audit remains explicit and non-default
retainedBoundaries.historicalEvidence: retained for traceability but excluded from current-task selection
retainedBoundaries.releaseRemeasureReason: explicit authorization received; focused stateful Release passed with migration, database shape, FileStore, worktree, and process reconciliation
